name: Huntsman
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
designRole: One choice to convert the Damsel to a Townsfolk; requires Damsel in setup.
explanation: One choice to convert the Damsel to a Townsfolk; requires Damsel in setup.

nightInstructions.firstNight: The Huntsman might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
nightInstructions.otherNights: The Huntsman might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

jinxes.reason: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added during setup.
